text:
Maria R.: Kicking off the 'thermostat' health-gate for release v2.1.4 — 2% traffic, 30m observation window. Routing EU+US. tagging @Kai @Sam :thermometer:

deploy-bot: deploy started: service=redwood-inference, image=v2.1.4, target=2%, mode=staged, window=30m

Sam T.: Obs request — link to release notes and the config used for the split?

Maria R.: Release notes https://internal.redwood/release/v2.1.4 — split config: `traffic_policy: thermostat; initial: 2%; metric_checks: [ttfb_p95, error_rate]`

Kai (oncall): Quick ask: can we make the ttfb_p95 threshold 400ms and error_rate threshold 1% for auto-hold? If either trips, hold and ping oncall.

Maria R.: yes will do, updating rollout policy now. will also pin model variant to `redwood/turbo-quant-1` for consistency.

deploy-bot: rollout policy updated: ttfb_p95_threshold=400ms, error_rate_threshold=1.0%, variant_pin=redwood/turbo-quant-1

Nina P.: Heads-up for support — notif to CS if hold happens? We should pre-warn enterprise tenants in EU5.

Maria R.: Yup — CS oncall notified and I scheduled a brief status email to tenant list if hold triggers. No customer-facing change unless we roll back.

deploy-bot: 15m metrics update: traffic=2%, ttfb_p95=360ms, error_rate=0.6%, small spike of 0.9% 5m ago. No auto-hold triggered.

Kai (oncall): Seeing a minor tail in TTFB on two nodes in eu-west-2, not widespread. Recommend continue but keep a close eye for next 10m.

Sam T.: Can we add a quick KV-cache warmup on those nodes? Might reduce tails.

Maria R.: kicked an async warmup job on the affected pool. noted.

deploy-bot: warmup job queued: job_id=wu-2026-176777

deploy-bot: 30m observation complete: final metrics: ttfb_p95=378ms, error_rate=0.7%, traffic=2%. No holds. Rollout stable.

Maria R.: Marking this gate as PASSED. Proceeding to gradual ramp to 10% over next 2h per schedule. I'll open a new thread for the ramp checklist.

Kai (oncall): Thanks — leaving a bookmark. Ping if anything breaches thresholds.

Nina P.: Thanks team — CS informed. :thumbsup:

Sam T.: thx all.
